title: Report
description: A report object provides supplemental information about a report

cardKey.description: Used to override the default cardKey, which is the cardKey of the card, in which the report macro is used

type.description: The kind of resource to list: cardTypes, templates, reports, workflows, fieldTypes, linkTypes, or skills

module.description: The prefix of the module, for example base. If not given, the prefix of the current project

category.description: List only the resources that have this category (templates, reports, and skills)

fields.description: For card types, also list the visible fields in their order
